contract.sample: LiftSample(reading_m, received_monotonic_ns, integrity, raw_hex); the protocol adapter may only read
contract.config: site_layout.lift = {source: DRAW_WIRE_SENSOR, sensor: {max_age_s, stationary_window_s, stationary_tolerance_m, uncertainty_m, each with *_basis; calibration: TWO_POINT (2 points) or ONE_POINT_SCALE (1 point + signed scale + scale_basis), basis}, optional range_m + range_basis (tighten only)}; no defaults
contract.calibration: overall height (base plate bottom to top plate top) from the reading; TWO_POINT never extrapolates (LIFT_SENSOR_OUTSIDE_CALIBRATED_SPAN)
contract.freeze: at the frozen RGB-D monotonic time: all samples CHECKED, latest age <= max_age_s, samples cover the stationary window, spread <= tolerance; h from the latest reading; interval = converted window min/max -/+ uncertainty; h inside the (tightened) machine range
contract.loader: mechanism mode with source DRAW_WIRE_SENSOR requires observation.lift_state (SITE_LIFT_FROZEN_SENSOR_STATE_REQUIRED) bound to the current sensor config hash (SITE_LIFT_SENSOR_CONFIG_CHANGED); boxes sweep the whole h interval
contract.sweep: translations swept exactly; inclined belt sampled with |dp/dh| <= 1 + r_max/dz_min so unsampled excursion <= 0.1 mm; brute-force check on the real manifest: every corner contained at 401 heights, growth 10.4 mm for +-5 mm
